administration_frequency.value: A 400 mg/m² loading dose is followed by 250 mg/m² weekly. For eligible RAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer after the specified prior treatments, continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
administration_frequency.source: NCCP 00207 v6, pages 1–2; current official PDF checked 2026-11-07; https://healthservice.hse.ie/documents/6941/207_Cetuximab_7day_.pdf

administration_frequency.value: A 400 mg/m² loading dose is given one week before radiotherapy, followed by 250 mg/m² weekly through the radiotherapy course. This context is locally advanced squamous-cell head and neck cancer with radiotherapy.
administration_frequency.source: NCCP 00207 v6, pages 1–2; current official PDF checked 2026-11-07; https://healthservice.hse.ie/documents/6941/207_Cetuximab_7day_.pdf
